posts.cooked:
evelogo519×202 3.61 KB

Hello capsuleers,

we would like to introduce EVE Capital (https://evecapital.fun), an investment platform for players who want to put their ISK to work over a longer period of time instead of letting it sit idle.

Our goal is simple:
to offer a clear, transparent, and easy-to-use way for investors to deposit ISK, track their capital, choose whether to compound their interest or let it be paid out every day and request withdrawals through a dedicated platform.

image1821×928 220 KB

NEW

LOYALTY PROGRAM
There are 6 loyalty levels. Level 1 uses the base monthly interest rate. Each higher level adds +0.5% to the monthly rate. You can only progress while your principal balance stays at or above the required minimum principal. Every 30 days without creating a capital withdrawal request, you move up one level, up to level 6. Creating a capital withdrawal request immediately resets your loyalty level back to level 1. If your principal balance drops below the required minimum, your loyalty level also falls back to level 1.

image1706×441 59.2 KB

What EVE Capital offers

1. Automated deposit recognition
Once you have logged in at least once with your character (Login is handled via official EVE SSO) , you can send ISK directly to the corporation EveCapital (3V3-C).
Our system automatically detects and matches deposits to your character.

2. Monthly interest rate with compound effect
The displayed interest rate (currently 2.5% and up to 5.0% in the loyalty program) is a monthly rate including compound interest.
Interest is calculated every minute, and investors can choose how they want it handled.

3. Optional compounding
Inside the dashboard, you can enable or disable automatic reinvestment of accrued interest into your principal.

  • If compounding is enabled, generated interest is credited directly into your capital account.

  • If compounding is disabled, interest is accumulated separately and paid out once per day.

4. Investor dashboard
Each investor gets access to a dashboard with:

  • principal balance

  • accrued interest

  • current monthly interest rate

  • deposit and withdrawal history

5. Withdrawal system with freeze period
Capital withdrawals can be requested at any time.
To protect the operational side of the business, withdrawals are subject to a 30-day freeze period before payout.

6. Affiliate Program
Every user gets a unique affiliate link. If a new user opens the website with your link and logs in for the first time. You will get 10% of his first deposit as a bonus directly to your own capital balance.

7. Transparent internal handling
The platform is designed to keep investor balances, generated interest, deposits, withdrawal requests, and history clearly separated and visible.

Why we built this

We actively trade and manufacture in EVE and operate several of our own trading and production structures, while also being present in the major trade hubs.
Additional capital allows us to scale faster, expand operations, and increase profit generation.

The platform exists to make the investor side of this process structured, easy to use, and transparent.

FAQ

What guarantee do I have that I will get my ISK back?

Summary

In short: none. We want to build and earn the trust of our investors over a long period of time. We cannot offer any guarantees in advance. The only thing we can do is consistently demonstrate that we handle deposits responsibly and always honor all payouts.

How does a deposit work?

Summary

You must have logged in on the website at least once with the character you want to use. After that, send the amount of ISK you want to deposit with that character to the corporation EveCapital (3V3-C). It is important that you send the ISK to the corporation, not to the CEO, and you can leave the transfer reason field empty. Our system detects your deposit automatically, but it can take up to one hour for the deposit to be credited because the EVE API caches wallet journal data and updates it with a delay.

How does a withdrawal work?

Summary

You can request a withdrawal from your capital account at any time. However, please note that these withdrawals are subject to a maximum 30-day lock period (we payout as fast as possible). We use the capital for trading, building new stations, and buying goods to hold and sell later under better market conditions. For that reason, the ISK is not sitting idle in our wallet and it takes time to withdraw it from our system. If you have disabled compound interest, your interest is paid out once per day directly to your character by transfer.

Do I also earn interest on my interest?

Summary

Yes. In the dashboard, you have the option to enable automatic reinvestment of accrued interest into your principal. The interest generated every minute is then credited directly to your capital account. If you disable this feature, the interest accumulates in a separate balance where it does not earn interest and is paid out once per day.

What do you do with the money?

Summary

In short: we trade and manufacture. We operate several of our own trading and production stations, while also being active in all major trade hubs. We need additional capital so we can expand quickly and generate more profit.

How much profit do you make?

Summary

Our own trading stations generate significantly more profit than trading in public trade hubs. At the moment, our average profit is around 19%.

Who exactly are “you”?

Summary

We are a group of players who have been active in EVE for more than a decade. We do not disclose the in-game names of our characters or stations, nor their locations. The reason is simple: we want to protect what we have already built, and with it the deposits of our investors. As everyone knows, there are many players in EVE whose gameplay revolves around destroying what others have built. Of course, we have secured ourselves against such risks through agreements with other alliances, but we also do not want to present ourselves as an obvious target.

Can the interest rate change?

Summary

Yes. We will always adjust the interest rate in line with our monthly profits whenever necessary.

How does the affiliate program work?

Summary

Every user receives a personal referral link in their dashboard. If a new user visits the platform through that link and logs in for the first time, the referral is permanently assigned to the inviting user. If that referred user then makes their first matched deposit, the inviter automatically receives a bonus equal to 10% of that first deposit. The bonus is credited directly to the inviter’s principal balance and also appears in the order history as an Affiliate Credit. Only the first successfully matched deposit of the referred user counts for the affiliate bonus.

How does the loyalty program work?

There are 6 loyalty levels. Level 1 uses the base monthly interest rate. Each higher level adds +0.5% to the monthly rate. You can only progress while your principal balance stays at or above the required minimum principal. Every 30 days without creating a capital withdrawal request, you move up one level, up to level 6. Creating a capital withdrawal request immediately resets your loyalty level back to level 1. If your principal balance drops below the required minimum, your loyalty level also falls back to level 1.

Is the displayed interest rate a monthly rate including compound interest?

Summary

Yes. The displayed interest rate is a monthly rate including compound interest.

If you are interested, you can visit the platform here:

https://evecapital.fun

posts.name: Eve Capital CEO
posts.cooked:
@Arch_Duke_Collin

Thank you for clarifying the structure. Now that we understand that the listing would require us to transfer actual in-game corporation shares to your exchange corporation, we have decided not to proceed.

The key issue is that these are not merely symbolic assets. In-game corporation shares carry real voting and governance rights. Even if we retain a large majority and therefore remain in control under normal circumstances, transferring genuine shares to an external corporation would still mean permanently giving up part of our direct control over those governance instruments.

Once transferred, those shares would no longer be under our sole control. We would have to trust that they remain in custody, are not transferred elsewhere, and are never used in a way that could affect our corporation. ESI verification may show where the shares are currently held, but it does not technically lock them, prevent transfers, or guarantee that they can be recovered.

For us, that is already an unnecessary risk.

The second and even more important issue concerns the investors on your platform.

According to your explanation, investors would not receive the actual in-game shares. The real shares would remain in the possession of the exchange corporation, while investors would only receive virtual shares recorded on your website.

That means they would not directly own shares in EVE Capital. They would own a claim against your platform.

Their entire position would therefore depend on the continued operation and integrity of the exchange. They would have to trust that:

  • the real shares remain in custody,

  • the virtual share records are accurate,

  • dividends are distributed correctly,

  • trades are processed correctly,

  • and the platform remains available.

If the website, database, or exchange corporation were to disappear, fail, or stop operating, those investors could be left with nothing more than a virtual record they can no longer access, while the actual in-game shares would still be held by the exchange corporation.

Unless investors have a clear and enforceable right to redeem their virtual shares for the real in-game shares, the virtual shares have no independent value outside your platform. Their value exists only as long as users trust your system and other buyers remain willing to trade them.

We are not comfortable attaching the EVE Capital name to such a structure.

There is also another important point: as far as we can see, no independent corporation has transferred its shares to your exchange yet. The only shares currently offered on the platform appear to be shares of your own corporation.

That means the exact process you are asking us to join has not yet been proven with an external corporation. There is no established track record showing how third-party shares are held over time, how dividends are passed through, how disputes are handled, how redemptions would work, or what happens if the platform or the exchange corporation encounters operational problems.

We do not want EVE Capital to be the first independent corporation to test an unproven custody and virtual-share system with real in-game governance assets.

Investors could also easily believe they are purchasing actual shares in EVE Capital, while in reality they are purchasing a platform-based representation of shares held by a third party. Any misunderstanding, failure, dispute, or loss on the exchange would inevitably affect the reputation of EVE Capital as well, even though we would not control the platform or the investor records.

For those reasons, we will not transfer genuine EVE Capital corporation shares to an external exchange, and we will not support the creation of virtual shares based on our corporation.

We prefer to maintain a direct and transparent relationship with our investors, without introducing an external custody layer or platform-dependent claims.

We wish you success with the exchange, but we have to decline the listing.

posts.name: Arch Duke Collin
posts.cooked:
@Eve_Capital_CEO

Thank you for such a detailed and considered response. Your concerns are legitimate and we want to address two directly.

On virtual shares having no independent value: investors holding 5% or more of any listing can redeem their virtual shares for the actual in-game shares at any time. Those shares are transferred directly to their character. Their position exists independently of our platform entirely at that point. CCP’s own game engine pays their dividends directly. We should have made this clearer upfront.

On custody security: the shares are held in our exchange corporation which is ESI-verified and publicly audited. We cannot transfer them without it being immediately visible. The in-game share voting mechanic also means any attempt to misuse custody shares would be detectable and reversible.

You’re right that we have no external track record yet. That’s a fair reason to wait. We’re not going to try to change your mind on timing.

When we’ve demonstrated the mechanics work with our own listings, we’d welcome another conversation.

We wish EVE Capital continued success.
